questions.question: A school organized a field trip for its students. There are 4 sections in Class 4, and each section has 35 students. Each bus hired for the trip can carry 30 students. How many buses are needed to take all the Class 4 students on the field trip?

options.explanation: This option is incorrect because 4 buses are not enough to carry all the students.
This option is incorrect because the correct option is C.
This option is correct because 5 buses are needed to take all the Class 4 students on the field trip.
This option is incorrect because 6 buses are not needed to carry all the students.

questions.explanation: Step 1: Calculate the total number of Class 4 students. Number of sections = 4, Students per section = 35, Total students = 4 × 35 = 140. Step 2: Calculate the number of buses needed. Capacity of one bus = 30 students, Number of buses = Total students ÷ Capacity per bus = 140 ÷ 30 = 4 R 20. 140 divided by 30 gives a quotient of 4 with a remainder of 20. This means 4 buses will carry 4 * 30 = 120 students, and there will be 20 students remaining. To carry these remaining 20 students, one more bus is needed. So, 4 + 1 = 5 buses are needed.
